occupation.value: former tech startup founder, currently unemployed/job-seeking
occupation.evidence: Was rising star in tech startup... Board lost confidence. Asked me to step down. My company, my baby, gone. Applying for jobs.

severity.evidence: Colonoscopy showed aggressive Crohn's. Entire colon affected. Severe dehydration, anemia. Hospitalization. Required high-dose prednisone, then azathioprine, then Humira — only 40% better.

disease_control.evidence: Started Humira six months ago. Helps some. Maybe 40% better. Not enough to return to previous life.

treatments.evidence: Started high-dose prednisone. Went from fit to bloated overnight.
